deviations.what: the original controller assigns one and the same aProducts array to four model keys (/ErrorProductCollection, /WarningProductCollection, /SuccessProductCollection, /InformationProductCollection) and binds one Select to each; the port folds them into the single shared table /T_PRODUCTS feeding all four Selects - same 16 rows, same sorter on NAME, each Select keeps its own two-way selectedKey, so rendering and behaviour are identical (app 048 precedent).
